title: Zymo Research Direct-zol™-96 MagBead RNA Kit
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Zymo Research Direct-zol™-96 MagBead RNA Kit
Temperature module is set to 4 C
Binding buffer is mixed to resuspend beads
Binding buffer is added to sample
Beads are resuspended, magnetic module engaged
Samples incubate 10 minutes with occasional mixing

steps.title: Set temperature module to 4 °C
steps.instruction: Place the temperature module on the deck and set it to 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in binding buffer
steps.instruction: Mix the supplied binding buffer thoroughly to fully resuspend the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Pipette the appropriate volume of binding buffer into each sample well.

steps.title: Mix on heater shaker for 10 min
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and manually place the plate on a heater‑shaker; mix the samples for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate on magnetic beads for 7 min
steps.instruction: Allow the samples to incubate with the magnetic beads for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Wash beads (3× cycle)
steps.instruction: Perform the following wash cycle three times:

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in the wash buffer and engage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add DNase and mix
steps.instruction: Add the specified volume of DNase to each sample and mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate DNase reaction 10 min
steps.instruction: Incubate the DNase‑treated samples for 10 minutes, mixing occasionally.

steps.title: Add stop reaction
steps.instruction: Add the stop‑reaction solution to each sample as directed.

steps.title: Add elution solution and cool
steps.instruction: Add the elution solution to each sample, then move the plate to the temperature module (still set to 4 °C).
